title: (Chat GPT) Pizza Tower and Sonic Mania Combined Mod
author: Sweaty-Campaign-1609
selftext:
Over the last month, I’ve seen a lot of people using Claude Code to mash up games, which really piqued my curiosity, so I decided to try something similar myself!

Since I don’t use Claude, I opted to experiment with ChatGPT to combine the gameplay of Pizza Tower with Sonic Mania.

This is just an initial test, and everything is still VERY experimental. There are still a few things to iron out, but I think the result is already quite interesting!

I just wanted to share my progress and see what you all think!
